---
# full-book.qmd
#
# Single-file HTML version of the whole book — for offline distribution
# or uploading to an LMS (Toledo, Brightspace, Canvas, Moodle, etc.) as
# one self-contained file, the same way decks/*.qmd gives you one
# self-contained file per slide deck.
#
# Same trick as the decks: this is a "loose" file (not listed under
# book: chapters: in ../_quarto.yml), so — same reasoning documented in
# decks/_metadata.yml and _quarto.yml — it does NOT reliably inherit the
# project-level `format: html:` block. So every setting is written out
# here in full, copied from _quarto.yml's html: block, rather than
# relying on inheritance.
title: "COURSE TITLE — Livre complet"
subtitle: ""
author: "Jérémy Genette"
date: last-modified

resource-path:
  - ..
  - ../chapters
  - ../chapters/images
  
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    self-contained-math: true
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    number-sections: true
    # search: true is a Quarto *website* feature (it builds a search
    # index as separate files) - it doesn't fit a single embed-resources
    # file, so it's left out here. Students get browser Ctrl+F instead.
    theme:
      light: [flatly, ../_shared/styles/kuleuven-book.scss]
      dark: [darkly, ../_shared/styles/kuleuven-book.scss]
---
